notes:
ACCEPTANCE BASELINE STUDY — Eight real carcass/shelf panels; support holes, pins, joints and anti-tip anchoring are not represented.

Casework shelves — PARTIAL DIMENSIONAL STUDY
Missing material: hardware.shelf-pins: Actual shelf supports, their quantities and a matching hole/installation system have not been selected or priced.
Missing material: hardware.anti-tip: Substrate-compatible anti-tip hardware and its attachment details have not been selected or priced.
Missing material: hardware.assembly-fasteners: Carcass/back-panel fastening hardware and purchase quantities have not been selected or priced.
Unresolved: casework-shelf-supports: Shelf pins/supports, hole diameters, spacing, edge distances, engagement and drilling templates are unspecified. No shelf support or hole pattern is generated.
Unresolved: casework-joinery: Carcass joints, rear-panel fixing, fastener quantities, edge treatment, backing/racking resistance and wall/anti-tip anchoring require design. No hardware is inferred as installed.
Unresolved: casework-fit-loads: Panel grade, shelf spans, intended loads and measured wall/baseboard/door obstructions remain unresolved. Shelf front setback is a provisional layout dimension, and zero lateral clearance is nominal geometry, not a fitted joinery or capacity approval.
Unresolved: material.caseworkPanels.installation: Dry interior cabinets, shelving and furniture using the selected BC sanded panel; nominal23/32 category uses reviewed .703-inch actual design thickness. Measure the purchased sheet and confirm panel stamp/grade before precision joinery; .703 inches is not .75 inches and manufacturer size tolerances still apply. This qualification is restricted to dry interior casework. Conflicting exposure descriptions do not establish wet-location, exterior, sauna or structural-seat suitability. The historical Lowe’s offer is retired; do not present it as a purchasable counterpart or import inventory for it.
